## Description

The assistant's knowledge comes from Medvya's existing services, doctors, branches and hours (read live, never copied) plus clinic-written FAQs and policies managed in clinic settings. Entries are indexed per tenant. The editor warns when an entry looks like patient data and refuses obvious identifiers.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Changing a doctor's hours in Medvya changes the assistant's answer without a second edit.
- [ ] **AC2.** A CarePlus assistant never answers from ValuePlus knowledge (test).
- [ ] **AC3.** An FAQ entry containing a phone number or national-ID-like value is refused.
- [ ] **AC4.** English, Hindi and Arabic entries; the settings screen passes axe in English and Arabic.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
